title: Executive Order No. 108, s. 2020
text:
MALACANAN PALACE
MANILA

BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 108

DIRECTING THE PHILIPPINE CHARITY SWEEPSTAKES OFFICE TO
SET ASIDE A PORTION OF THE STANDBY FUND UNDER EXECUTIVE
ORDER NO. 201 (S. 2003) TO COVER THE FINANCIAL
REQUIREMENTS OF THE NATIONAL GOVERNMENT’S RESPONSE TO
CASES OF COVID-19 IN THE COUNTRY, AMENDING EO NO. 201 AND
FOR OTHER PURPOSES

WHEREAS, Article II, Section 15 of the Constitution provides that the State shall
protect and promote the right to health of the people and instill health consciousness
among them;

; WHEREAS, Executive Order (EO) No. 201 (s. 2003) instituted measures to
confine, restrict and prevent the further spread of the Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome
(SARS) outbreak, setting aside for said purpose an amount not exceeding P'1 Billion from
the funds of the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO);

WHEREAS, the Inter-Agency Task Force for the Management of Emerging
Infectious Diseases (IATF-MEID) under EO No. 168 (s. 2014) is mandated to establish
the systems and protocols necessary for the management of emerging infectious
diseases in the country, such as COVID-19;

WHEREAS, the Department of Health (DOH) has confirmed the first local
transmission of COVID-19 in the country and has elevated the COVID-19 alert system to
Code Red status;

WHEREAS, through Board Resolution No. 0077 (s. 2020), the PCSO, in
consultation with the DOH, resolved and recommended the utilization of fifty percent
(50%) of the remainder of the standby fund under EO No. 201 to cover the financial
requirements for the management of COVID-19 cases in the country; and

WHEREAS, there is a need to mobilize resources in order to facilitate and amplify
measures for the management of COVID-19 in the country;

NOW THEREFORE, |, RODRIGO ROA DUTERTE, President of the Philippines,
by virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution and existing laws, do hereby
order:
 
SECTION 1. The PCSO is hereby directed to set aside the amount of
R420,585,000.00, corresponding to fifty percent (50%) of the remainder of the standby
fund under Section 4 of EO No. 201, to cover the financial requirements for the treatment,
containment, prevention and management of COVID-19 cases in the country. The other
50% shall continue to cover the funding necessary to respond to future cases of SARS in
the Philippines.

The IATF-MEID, through the DOH, shall coordinate with the PCSO relative to the
release of the abovementioned funds, subject to applicable budgeting, accounting and
auditing laws, rules and regulations.

SECTION 2. Except for the foregoing amendment, all other provisions of EO No.
201 shall remain in full force and effect.

SECTION 3. This Order shall take effect immediately.

DONE, in the City of Manila, this 14th day of March , in the
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand Twenty.

 

By the President:
